observations.behavior: Adds a 14-day grace period and a blocking-from-date to the ratchet enforcement, with a warning and GitHub summary, and an AssertionError once the grace period expires.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows a baseline mismatch to remain non-blocking for up to 14 days, then fail the build; this could help staged rollouts of stricter checks without immediately breaking CI.

observations.behavior: Replaces a bare AssertionError with a call to enforce_baseline, passing a blocking-from date and a message, and no longer raises immediately.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses the ratchet to defer enforcement of a database-free test class baseline; this could allow a team to fix violations over a grace period before the check becomes blocking.
